realized_head_accounting.capture: the fused realized o_proj output at the input to post_attention_layernorm
realized_head_accounting.theoretical_head_terms: evaluate each o_proj column slice in FP32 on the captured pre-o_proj query-head vector
realized_head_accounting.projection_numerical_residual: captured fused o_proj output minus the sum of FP32 head terms and the optional o_proj bias
realized_head_accounting.projection_residual_allocation: add exactly one divided by num_attention_heads of the projection numerical residual to every query-head term
realized_head_accounting.shared_denominator: compute from the captured fused o_proj output using the actual RMSNorm epsilon and learned Gemma one-plus-weight scale
realized_head_accounting.normalization_numerical_residual: captured normalized branch minus the sum of shared-denominator head terms and optional bias term
realized_head_accounting.normalization_residual_allocation: add exactly one divided by num_attention_heads of the normalization numerical residual to every query-head allocation
required_report: projection numerical residual max absolute value
normalization numerical residual max absolute value
final allocation closure max absolute error
realized_head_accounting.interpretation: the residual shares are symmetric numerical bookkeeping; all per-head allocations remain accounting quantities, not causal effects

direct_path_attention.matched_recomputation: the target and counterfactual response-only terms use identical shape, device, dtype, o_proj, post-attention RMSNorm, and kernel path
direct_path_attention.identity_requirement: when selected source and target head values are equal, the bracketed delta must be exactly zero and the cached realized target branch must be returned
direct_path_attention.scope: numerical implementation of the already frozen selected-head substitution and later-write freeze; no causal site or estimand changes

unchanged: K12, K4 MLP, K16, and nonselected populations
